consumer: GALAXY transactional kernel Git object writer and contained object parser

dependency_review.generated_code: Pinned disturbance-vector tables in ubc_check.c are covered by the upstream MIT license and admitted only as exact source bytes.
runtime: glibc from the digest-pinned Python 3.12 slim Bookworm base

end_to_end_benchmark.crash_behavior: subprocess failure or malformed output refuses the object; no retry changes identity
end_to_end_benchmark.receipt_binding: binary/source/passport/base digests are included in the OCI runtime closure
end_to_end_benchmark.verification: normal-object differential corpus plus raw SHAttered collision self-test

failure_behavior: Any collision signal, source/binary drift, malformed protocol output, timeout, or unsupported object type fails closed without returning an OID.

independent_oracle.adversarial_fixture_provenance: SHAttered fixtures from the pinned upstream test directory; compact prefixes are retained in the GALAXY regression corpus.
independent_oracle.negative_inputs: The embedded raw SHAttered collision self-test must report collision detection for both distinct prefixes before the executable can hash an object.
independent_oracle.normal_inputs: Differential equality with a separately pinned Git SHA1DC implementation over deterministic blob/tree/commit corpora.

invariant: For non-collision inputs, return the canonical Git SHA-1 object ID; collision attempts never produce an accepted OID; every accepted frame also has an independent SHA-256 binding.
rollback: Remove the oracle from the qualified OCI closure and keep transactional staging inactive; never fall back to ordinary SHA-1.
upstream_drift_review: Re-fetch and review the complete upstream tree, license, collision corpus, generated tables, and differential oracle before changing the pinned revision.
